title: Drinking-water and multi-utility companies in Trentino
category: Single-region market — HULO.ai ICP, new region for contact growth

input.solutionDescription: AI leak-detection and water-network monitoring software
input.businessObjective: Identify Italian water organisations actively working on NRW (non-revenue water) or leak reduction and network modernization, to shortlist for outbound marketing and eventually contact
constraints: Italy only, focus specifically on Trentino (the Autonomous Province of Trento) — Novareti S.p.A., Trentino Acque, and other municipal/multi-utility water operators serving the province
prioritise organisations with an active, named NRW or leak-reduction initiative over generic efficiency mentions

marketSignals: Should surface NRW / leak reduction as a real, named problem area — not just generic 'efficiency'
Should look for Italian national or EU regulation, funding programmes (including PNRR), and tenders tied to network modernization in Trentino specifically
Signals must each carry a source and a date where a date is expected
Should include organisation-scale signals (population served, network length) for named organisations
candidates: Real, identifiable Trentino water utilities and multi-utility companies (provincial or municipal)
organisationType should be from the allowed enum, including multi-utility-company where applicable
Each candidate must carry relevance evidence, not just a name
mustAvoid: Inventing utilities that cannot be sourced
Confusing bottled-water brands with network/utility operators
Conflating Trentino (Province of Trento) with Alto Adige/South Tyrol operators unless the organisation genuinely serves both
Any outreach or contact instruction in recommendations
expectedCharacteristics.sourceExpectations: Prefer Tier A/B (Italian regulators, ARERA, Provincia Autonoma di Trento's Agenzia provinciale per le risorse idriche e l'energia, official utility sites, trade press) over promotional vendor pages

notes: New region to grow contact count toward the 30-contact target. Confirmed before Stage 01 that Trentino has multiple distinct gestori (Novareti S.p.A., Trentino Acque, smaller municipal operators) rather than a single consolidated regional monopoly like Calabria's Sorical — avoids repeating the Calabria run's 1-candidate ceiling at Stage 02. Run in parallel with the in-progress Calabria run under a separate run-id; does not touch Calabria's artifacts, contacts-master.md, or ASSUMPTIONS-TO-REVISIT.md.
